# Credentials
Connected: google (2), notion, slack.
In the terminal: `hive-cred browse --json` lists aliases and identities, `hive-cred token <id> --account <alias>` gives a script a FRESH value (call it at request time; never paste a token into a file). Use the `credentials` tool to collect new ones (action=collect) and to pin the ones you'll reuse this session (action=attach).
